rationale: The exact decision's provisional NO recommendation is supported within the supplied source perimeter. EO 13788 §§1–6, 82 FR 18837–18839 (PDF pp.1–3). Section 3 includes continuous Buy American monitoring/enforcement, assessments, policy proposals, recurring agency and Commerce reports; §4 governs public-interest waivers; §5 separately directs immigration rules/guidance and H-1B reforms. The immigration branch and later-year reporting must be covered, not silently reduced to procurement. EO 14005 §14(a), 86 FR 7478 (PDF p.4), revokes EO 13788 without a subject-matter or section limitation. The explicit limitation to §5 applies to neighboring EO 13858. Section 14(b)'s inconsistency qualification applies only to EO 10582/13881. Therefore the revocation covers both Buy American and Hire American commands. EO 13788 §6(a)(iii) preserves existing international-agreement rights/obligations and §§6(a)–(c) contain general savings. Those obligations rest elsewhere; they do not continue EO 13788's separate directives. Agency rules implementing its policies need their own analysis but are not a target-order savings clause. EO 14148's complete revocation list does not name EO 14005 or EO 13788; its broad policy language and review directions are not affirmative restoration of this order.
